item.title: Trump asks UFC chief Dana White to be White House press secretary
item.description: Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO says he will meet with the US president on Monday to discuss the offer.

item.title: Egypt sacks winning football coach after wives’ scandal
item.description: The Egyptian Football Association has sacked national team coach Hossam Hassan, cutting short a promising tenure.

item.title: US launches task force to disrupt Iran’s land-based supply routes
item.description: The operation is to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport weapons and other materials, US says.

item.title: Canary Islands’ El Hierro declares emergency amid migrant, refugee influx
item.description: El Hierro asks Spanish government for help after more than 3,300 people arrived on boats since start of November.

item.title: Polish PM calls deadly Krakow shooting an act of ‘terrorism’
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk describes a deadly shooting in Krakow that killed six people as an act of ‘terrorism’.

item.title: Iran war live: US moves to block land supply routes; UAE rescues 22 sailors
item.description: Iranian state media report blasts on Qeshm Island in Strait of Hormuz and the cities of Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas.

item.title: Eisenkot chosen over Netanyahu to form Israel’s next government
item.description: Israel's president asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form the next gov't over Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Real Madrid beat Valencia 3-0 to draw level with La Liga leaders Barcelona
item.description: Valverde and Guler's first-half goals put Madrid in the driving seat, and Mbappe added a third in the second half.

item.title: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
item.description: Police have clashed with protesters in Paris as Yellow Vests defied a ban on their rally, leading to arrests.

item.title: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President
item.description: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President

item.title: Who is behind Europe’s suspected hybrid attacks?
item.description: Bomb hoaxes and supermarket cyberattacks are heightening security fears.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed slams Trump’s tariff war with Canada
item.description: Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed has criticised Trump’s trade war with Canada.

item.title: Israel’s president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form next government
item.description: Isaac Herzog formally gives Gadi Eisenkot 28 days to secure 61 Knesset seats and replace Netanyahu as prime minister.

item.title: More than 140,000 rally as new protests against rising costs sweep France
item.description: Tear gas fired in Paris and Lyon as interior minister warns authorities are 'ready and waiting' for rioters and looters.

item.title: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in
item.description: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia, once a refuge for those fleeing the war, is now facing growing danger.

item.title: Paraguay’s ousted president appears before prosecutors after impeachment
item.description: Former Paraguayan President Santiago Pena has appeared before prosecutors.

item.title: Masked protesters set off firecrackers and block roads in Albania
item.description: Police used water cannons to disperse masked protesters in Albania’s capital, Tirana.

item.title: Trump orders DOJ to investigate Democrats for ‘threatening’ people
item.description: Trump lashed out at Democrats on Truth Social days after the party won control of Congress.

item.title: How did AIPAC-backed candidates fare in the US midterm elections?
item.description: Many candidates the pro-Israel group backed still won, but most of the money it spent went to candidates who lost.

item.title: Malaysian king warns against defying house arrest order for ex-PM Najib
item.description: Attorney general postponed Najib Razak’s transfer from jail after court cleared him for house arrest on Friday.

item.title: Latvian farmers protest over ‘blood grain’ trade with Russia
item.description: Latvian farmers are protesting Russian grain transit, arguing that it helps fund Moscow’s war in Ukraine.

item.title: Yemeni gov’t forces report advances as Houthis say deadly strikes hit Sanaa
item.description: Civilians bear the brunt of fighting as 27 people reported killed in strikes on a village in Sanaa province.

item.title: Demonstration in Berlin calls for an end to arming Israel
item.description: Demonstration in Berlin calls for an end to arming Israel

item.title: Houston mayor orders police to limit cooperation with ICE
item.description: Houston Mayor John Whitmire has instructed police to limit contact with ICE, reversing the city’s previous approach.

item.title: Paraguay’s ousted president charged over banking scandal
item.description: Santiago Pena was impeached over the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions unable to access their accounts.
